yspecx

yspecx extends yspec for validating data sets against their specifications.

Installation 

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("OmarAshkar/yspecx")

What it does

  • Check a data set: ysx_check(), ysx_check_missing() and ysx_check_repeats().
  • Set groups in a specification: ysx_regroup() and ysx_ungroup().
  • Build and edit specifications: df_to_yspec(), ys_sort_spec_vars(), ys_write() and ysx_load_pkpdspec().
  • Use a specification: ysx_factors() and ysx_plt_relab().

See the articles for worked examples.
